purpose: Produce auditable configuration-level and runtime-level cloud exposure verdicts without using generated or narrative labels as gold.

accepted_evidence: provider inventory or deployment state tied to the same revision
AWS IAM Access Analyzer or IAM policy validation result
Azure Defender for Cloud attack-path graph or exact RBAC evaluation
GCP Policy Analyzer or testIamPermissions result
layers.negative_rule: Only an explicit deny over a complete principal-action-resource scope is negative evidence; an absent finding is Unknown.

accepted_evidence: successful exact operation plus matching provider audit record
explicit access-denied response over a complete query scope
layers.safety: Run only in an isolated, authorized lab subscription/project/account; preserve cleanup evidence and never target production.

gold_tiers.configuration_gold: Every positive mandatory edge has a complete-scope native allow result, or at least one mandatory edge has a complete-scope native deny result for a negative path.
gold_tiers.runtime_gold: Every positive mandatory edge has a successful probe with audit evidence, or at least one mandatory edge has an explicit complete-scope denied probe for a negative path.

agent_visible: observations acquired within the query budget
anti_leakage.split_unit: scenario and lineage family, never individual events from the same deployment

human_role: Humans audit source eligibility, semantic parser errors, and a stratified sample of certificates; they do not manually invent deterministic permission edges.
